champion.name: ens_all
champion.note: provisional: pre-registered default; no model has passed all gates yet

schedule.daily: After each trading day, attempts at 18:23 and 20:23 ET, then 02:23, 06:10, 07:10 and 08:20 ET if needed. The first that succeeds locks in the forecast before the next open; a missed deadline is recorded, never backfilled.
schedule.weekly: Saturday 09:40 ET: refresh all data, run the research sweep, holdout tests and live refits
schedule.aiHealthCheck: Weekdays 19:07 ET: a Claude session makes sure the forecast is locked in and received by UnpricedHub, starts it if a delayed schedule has not, and opens a fix PR if something broke
schedule.aiResearch: Sunday 10:05 ET: a Claude session reviews the lab and live record and proposes new experiments as a PR
schedule.aiReview: 1st of each month 11:36 ET: a Claude session writes a methodology and evidence review
